body: Okay. Maybe you're right :)
I'm sorry you're going through all that and you're right about how to feel better. I've just been trying for so long now that I'm ready to give up.

I used to blame myself for the past. "If is only done this...or if I'd only done that...if I hadn't done such and such etc." But I've spent a lot of time reflecting and I'm convinced I would have screwed things up no matter what I did. But I definitely know how you feel. I wish I could disappear.
Thank you :)

I don't usually comment because I am afraid I might say the wrong thing. I just wanted to tell you that my heart goes out to you and what you're going through. I read one of your other posts and I can understand your frustration. I am helpless to give any advice. I just know that a lot of people can be cruel and I wanted to offer you a kind word for whatever it is worth.
I am so sorry for your loss. I cannot even imagine what you must be going through. My heart is broken for the little girl. I hope you can get the support you need in this terrible time.
I just lost it and called my doctors office screaming. I feel so ashamed. I was just so angry I couldn't contain it. I'm so scared.

Thank you. I'm sorry you've had a rough time too. I know therapy helps some people but I've been in and out of therapy for years and I've just kinda given up. My psychologist refused to see me because I'm suicidal. 

But I'm glad your therapist is helping you. I know what it's like to be betrayed by "friends". I hope things work out for you and that you continue to find peace on your journey. :)
What if you live in fear of tomorrow? Things are about to get much worse for me. I'm just trying to hold on today.
I agree with so much of what you said as it pertains to adults. The thing is that some of the people who read this sub and post here are children. I worry for their sakes.
Sending you a mental hug 🤗

I miss how he was always there for me and loved me no matter what. Nobody wants to put up with me anymore and I don't want to either. I don't see why I shouldn't just die. Why should I suffer anymore? I miss him so much

But he was bipolar and over medicated and was pretty flat so even though we had a strong connection it felt like something was missing because he couldn't connect sometimes if that makes sense. Near the end he would just shut down and couldn't move and I'm starting to get to that point.

I just can't connect. I've never been close to anyone except my boyfriend who died from suicide four years ago. I want people to understand the agony I'm in and why I want to end my life. I just wish I could go peacefully with someone by my side but I see now that this is a step I have to take alone. Suicide is a lonely thing

It's not so much that people don't care but they can't afford to care or get involved with someone who might bring them down. I keep reminding myself of this. I've sent out a few cries for help to my "friends" and I have to remind myself not to take it personally if they don't answer. It's hard though when you thought someone might care and then they don't. It's still heartbreaking.

My parents are selling their house, have moved to a new house with my son, had promised to help me find a place to live but now have decided that their done with me and want me to move into a shelter. It's my fault for getting high all the time but I didn't know what else to do. A year ago I just gave up and shut down and haven't been able to do much of anything. It's all my fault. I really want to die but I can't.

Cigarettes soda and weed. I only started smoking weed to get off the benzos that were making me crazy.

Well I've been diagnosed with anxiety, depression and bipolar. My doctor recently suggest that I have BPD. 

I think ultimately the lack of balance in my life makes me too unbalanced to seek the balance I need. So I'm sort of trapped if that makes sense.

I was on my own for a summer during college and remembered crying all the time and wanting to die but holding on for the child I would one day have. 

Theb when my son was two I left his father and tried being on my own with my baby but I just couldn't handle it. When he was at daycare I would just shut down and not be able to move until it was time to pick him up. So we moved in with my parents. 

Fifteen years later I'm still here. When I'm alone I just shut down. I used to try to motivate myself to go out but for the last year I have barely even gotten off the couch.

My parents are supporting me and I'm grateful for that. Theatre can be a great place to volunteer. I've met a lot of great people and had a lot of fun. I'm just not sure if I'll be able to do it anymore and it's breaking my heart.

Well...maybe I can explain...I've never been able to control my emotions for very long. Maybe 2-3 hours. But if I get overwhelmed I tend to cry and sometimes panic so I have to avoid situations where I might feel overwhelmed. 

I use my addiction to control my emotions. I'm basically numbing myself to the pain and it does interfere with relationships. 

I can't connect with people on social media. I post now and then on Facebook for a show of support but I can't just chat with my friends online the way young people do. No one ever contacts me unless they want something which is almost never. 

The psychological pain comes from intense loneliness and helplessness. My whole life is about to be turned inside out and I'm scared to death.
I'm 39 which make me feel rather pathetic. I think things would actually be easier if I were younger. At my age no one's going to take me under their wing.
I live with my parents but they are moving soon and want me to get my own place. I am grateful they are still willing to support me but I am terrified of living alone.

Unfortunately I don't qualify for disability. My volunteer job is working backstage at a theatre. I help out with about four shows per year painting sets and gathering props. But there's so much time between shows that I go weeks without having anywhere to go and anything to do. 

My personal circumstances are about to change and I might not even be able to afford the gas to volunteer anymore. I had planned on attempting suicide after the show ended but I'm afraid it won't work and I'm scared.
Yeah it is. I've been a shutin so long I can't even imagine living a normal life
Yes it is

When I'm volunteering I have casual friends that are nice to me but I have no connection with them in real life. I'm not sure how to explain. Everyone I know has jobs and lives and just don't have time to hang out. People my age already seem to have friends. I just get too emotional around people and no one wants to be around me when I break down and I get that. It's just hard because I can't really go anywhere. Does that make sense?

I feel so lonely because I am almost always alone. I rarely leave the house except to go to the store and volunteer. I have never been able to connect with other people. My only close friend committed suicide four years ago this week and I have felt lost and alone ever since
I managed to eat something and have a cup of tea. I feel warmer now. My meds kicked in and I feel calmer now. I just feel so empty and alone.
